BillHeading.Sponsors: Representatives Van Werven, Clibborn, and Buys
BillHeading.BriefDescription: Modifying the use of motor vehicle and special fuel tax proceeds by border area transportation benefit districts.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to border area transportation benefit districts; and amending RCW 82.47.030.

BillSection.BillSectionHeader: Sec. 1. RCW 82.47.030 and 1991 c 173 s 3 are each amended to read as follows:Proceeds.
BillSection.P: The entire proceeds of the tax imposed under this chapter, less refunds authorized by the resolution imposing such tax and less amounts deducted by the border area jurisdiction for administration and collection expenses, shall be used solely for the purposes of border area jurisdiction street maintenance and constructiontransportation improvements, as defined in RCW 36.73.015.

AnnNote.NoteP: Effective date—1991 c 173: See note following RCW 82.47.010.
